summary: Round 15 plan check (files only, no Kaggle API calls, 05:31-05:50Z 27 Sep). The D1 read is CORRECT: it matches watch.log (3 fresh events, count 40->43, UP test FAIL each time, exp70a NEU and exp70d/exp70e NEG), the ledger (all three have L_hi <= 7.42 h, insertion gate did NOT fire) and the read sheet row D1-3. The pair stays {#37, #38}, BASE is none and there is no combo. Probes 43/44 (exp70j DC 0.20, exp70k DC 0.225): the dummies re-verify exactly from _dl/ (shas, nodes, forks 96/88, 0 error lines, insertion unchanged at 12, runtimes 1,477/1,427 s). W6 holds (header 8.0 min old, no 429). The notebook diff vs K2 is one env line. 'Class C' is the right label under L9. BUT the two submits break three pre-registered clauses that the 04:59 entry never names: R13-A1 (1) 'no threshold neighbours, no class C', R13-A1 (5a) 'the ladder ends after 42 with no POS base', and the cap 'at most 5 ladder submits' (now 6). The P(>=0.955) prior of 0.2-0.3 ignores I-018 (sjlee DC 0.20 and 0.25 tied on public) and the negative 6bba lab; a fair figure is ~0.08-0.15. Both submits (05:28Z) and an E10 snapshot (05:31:16Z) fell inside the 04:10-06:45Z quiet window. No 429 resulted, and the claim 'watcher paused' has no PAUSE line in the watcher log. Needed before ~12:30Z: a deviation record plus a freeze on further DC or ladder rungs; a pre-registered class-C read rule (plateau, tie order, L_hi clocks, pair, re-tick budget); an updated 07:30Z push and brief with a Q4 on class C; the API SELECTED read and log. E10 P1 at 05:31Z was NOT met.

findings.what: Probes 43/44 break pre-registered clauses that the 04:59/05:28 UTC entries do not name. (a) R13-A1 (1): 'No other rung: no threshold neighbours (I-310), no class C'. (b) R13-A1 (5)(a): the ladder ends after 42 when there is no POS base, and D1 found BASE none. (c) R13-A1 (5): 'At most 5 ladder submits in total'; 39-44 makes 6. (d) L9 and r_ladder (d): 'no threshold neighbours ... pure public fitting with no lab support'. The user's 20:33Z lift covers public probes, but R13-A1 was the session's own later self-restriction (01:31Z, pushed 3d48d35). Labelling the rungs 'post-hoc, class C' is honest but incomplete. With no freeze, the 13:00Z scores invite a dc 0.175/0.15 chase or dc+fm45 combos, which would be an open-ended public knob ladder.

A class-C file is eligible iff: (1) COMPLETE without error; (2) its runtime_ledger row gives L_hi <= 9.0 h (first COMPLETE header by 14:28:13Z for j and 14:28:22Z for k; the 8.0 h insertion marks are 13:28:13Z/13:28:22Z, so quote the ledger text); (3) display >= 0.955; (4) PLATEAU: the other DC neighbour displays >= 0.954 (the analogue of L9's single-knob >= 0.954 and ADDENDUM L1's plateau).
